data.title: D · 餐桌旁的假戏真做深陷
data.description: 烛光微醺的餐桌旁，围裙系带已然松散。平日冷静的杀手坐在餐桌边缘，针织裙领口滑落，双手紧紧揪住你的衬衫衣襟。在热烈的深吻中，她防线尽失，喘息滚烫而无助。
data.location: safehouse dining room illuminated by warm candlelight
data.action: seated on edge of dining table with apron strings undone and dress slipping off shoulder, clinging tightly in breathless passionate kiss, blushing fiercely
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight creating dramatic intimate shadows
data.mood: broken composure, intense romantic surrender, heated newlywed passion
data.promptProse: Sitting on the dining table edge with her apron untied, D kisses partner deeply with breathless moans and a fierce newlywed blush.
